CaseStudies.title: UNICSI - Multi-Tier Dropshipping SaaS Platform
CaseStudies.overview: A multi-role dropshipping platform connecting suppliers, Shopify-based resellers, and administrators through one operational system.
CaseStudies.challenge: Suppliers, dropshippers, and platform administrators needed to coordinate catalogue data, Shopify stores, orders, fulfilment, inventory, and financial operations without relying on disconnected manual processes. The platform also needed strong role boundaries and a delivery setup that could evolve safely as the product grew.

approach.title: Model the roles
approach.description: Defined clear capabilities and data boundaries for Suppliers, Dropshippers, and Super Admin users before shaping the platform modules.

approach.title: Connect the lifecycle
approach.description: Mapped products, imports, Shopify stores, orders, inventory, fulfilment, and financial operations as one connected commerce lifecycle.

approach.title: Design for operations
approach.description: Created centralized administration and automated delivery so the team could operate and release the platform reliably.

implementation.title: Shopify integration layer
implementation.description: Built workflows that let dropshippers import supplier products and synchronize orders bidirectionally with connected Shopify stores.

implementation.title: Automated order routing
implementation.description: Connected incoming store orders to the appropriate supplier fulfilment panels, reducing repetitive manual coordination.

implementation.title: Central Super Admin
implementation.description: Delivered real-time oversight and control for users, orders, inventory, and financial activity across the platform.

implementation.title: AWS delivery pipeline
implementation.description: Established CI/CD across platform services using AWS infrastructure to support consistent, zero-downtime releases.

outcomes.title: Unified operations
outcomes.description: Products, orders, inventory, users, and financial activity can be managed through one platform.

outcomes.title: Less manual fulfilment
outcomes.description: Shopify synchronization and supplier routing automate key parts of the dropshipping workflow.

outcomes.title: Safer releases
outcomes.description: The CI/CD pipeline enables repeatable deployments without planned platform downtime.

CaseStudies.title: OWR - Online Store Management SaaS
CaseStudies.overview: A multi-tenant operating system for commerce, logistics, payments, wallets, and subscriptions.
CaseStudies.challenge: Online sellers needed a single system to manage daily store operations. Product data, orders, logistics partners, customer payments, wallet balances, and recurring subscriptions all had to work together while remaining isolated for each tenant.

approach.title: Unify store workflows
approach.description: Organized product, order, shipment, payment, wallet, and subscription capabilities around the complete store operating cycle.

approach.title: Isolate tenant data
approach.description: Designed the SaaS workflows so multiple stores could use shared services while retaining clear operational boundaries.

approach.title: Abstract integrations
approach.description: Kept logistics and payment providers behind focused integration layers to simplify business workflows and future changes.

implementation.title: Commerce management
implementation.description: Built product administration and order-processing workflows for the day-to-day operation of online stores.

implementation.title: Logistics connectivity
implementation.description: Integrated Delhivery and Shiprocket to create and track shipments through real-time provider workflows.

implementation.title: Payment processing
implementation.description: Connected PhonePe and Razorpay payment gateways to checkout and transaction-management flows.

implementation.title: Wallets and subscriptions
implementation.description: Developed an in-app wallet and subscription billing capabilities within the same tenant-aware platform.

outcomes.title: One operating system
outcomes.description: Stores can manage catalogue, orders, shipments, payments, and billing without switching between disconnected tools.

outcomes.title: Flexible fulfilment
outcomes.description: Multiple logistics providers give operators more control over shipment creation and tracking.

outcomes.title: Built-in monetization
outcomes.description: Payment gateways, wallets, and subscriptions support transactional and recurring revenue workflows.

CaseStudies.title: Dukkandaar - E-Commerce & SaaS Platform
CaseStudies.overview: A modular commerce platform with separate Admin, Seller, and Buyer products across web and mobile.
CaseStudies.challenge: A marketplace experience had to serve three audiences with very different responsibilities: administrators managing the ecosystem, sellers running their businesses, and buyers shopping across web and mobile. Shared commerce features needed to stay consistent without turning the applications into one tightly coupled interface.

approach.title: Separate user journeys
approach.description: Divided the experience into dedicated Admin, Seller, and Buyer modules with role-specific navigation and capabilities.

approach.title: Share the commerce core
approach.description: Centralized common product, promotion, order, and analytics rules behind the web and mobile experiences.

approach.title: Plan for two clients
approach.description: Structured features so React web interfaces and the React Native application could consume consistent backend behavior.

implementation.title: Role-based modules
implementation.description: Implemented focused workspaces for platform administration, seller operations, and the buyer shopping journey.

implementation.title: Promotions engine
implementation.description: Added coupon and promotional-deal workflows that could be managed by authorized roles and applied during shopping.

implementation.title: Live analytics
implementation.description: Created dashboards that surface current business activity and performance to operational users.

implementation.title: Cross-platform mobile app
implementation.description: Delivered the buyer-facing mobile experience using React Native alongside the web platform.

outcomes.title: Clear role ownership
outcomes.description: Each audience receives a purpose-built workflow while operating on the same commerce platform.

outcomes.title: Web and mobile reach
outcomes.description: Buyers can access the shopping experience through both browser and cross-platform mobile clients.

outcomes.title: Actionable visibility
outcomes.description: Real-time dashboards help administrators and sellers understand ongoing platform activity.
